programmes.d: Logan decides to write and direct a low-budget action film at the beach using a real shark.
When Mitch Judges the Miss Malibu Beach Bikini Contest his willpower is tested.
Max, a secretly rich homeless eccentric man, suddenly dies and leaves CJ his fortune.
At the annual Baywatch Bachelor Auction, Mitch is "bought" for $5,000 by a wealthy socialite.
LA is in the throes of a severe heat wave! Hundreds of thousands of people head to the beach.
Mitch hires MTV DJ Jenny McCarthy to throw "Beachblast" to raise money for the Special Olympics.
CJ's mother, a former Las Vegas showgirl, arrives in town to get away from her mobster ex-boyfriend.
Australia's Uncle Toby's International Ironman Competition sparks a battle of the sexes.
Controversy generated by Donna's appearance in Playboy magazine divides the Baywatch lifeguards.
Fire chief Captain Huntingdon and the Baywatch team form an elite joint Search and Rescue unit.
The team works with Heal the Bay after a recent rainstorm washes inland pollutants onto the beach.
Mitch has been chosen Flash Magazine's Bachelor of the Month, which causes some complications.
Stephanie and Tom go on their honeymoon in a two-mast schooner with a group of troubled teenagers.
Mitch gets his “15 minutes of fame” when he rescues Jay Leno from choking.
Caroline, Neely and Manny rescue three orphan teenage boys from drowning.
Manny is haunted by his past when two juvenile delinquents from his hometown arrive at Baywatch.
When a young couple’s romance is threatened by their parents, they make a pact to end their lives.
While testing new scuba diving technology, Sam, Neely and Caroline witness a jet crash.
CJ and Cody transport an injured sea lion to the animal recovery facility at Sea World.
Caroline finds herself being sued for negligence in civil court by the mother of a drowning victim.
A crazed young woman is causing trouble on the Venice Boardwalk and Neely suspects something is up.
A mysterious, disfigured man who the public dubs "the phantom lifeguard," is secretly saving people.
Lifeguard candidates compete for a chance to attend Rookie School and become Baywatch Lifeguards.
When a jet skier comes after April, Hobie finally shows that he's got Lifeguarding in his blood.
Veteran lifeguard Jack 'JD' Darius and Taylor Walsh both vie for the open Lieutenant slot.
Mitch, Sky and April find a dead man at the bottom of the ocean and search for answers.
April has trouble dealing with her brother’s cancer, but Mitch helps her see how special he is.
The lifeguards are plagued by a reporter who knows too much and gets in the way.
Seismic activity causes problems for the lifeguards.
When two sea lions are killed in an unexplainable event, Mitch must find the cause and stop it.
